$comment: Single source of truth for every Mapbox plugin package. Do not hand-edit the generated manifests (.claude-plugin/, .plugin/, .mcp.json, .agents/plugins/marketplace.json, plugins/mapbox/.codex-plugin/plugin.json); edit this file and run npm run build:plugin. Staging URLs are not committed: put them in the gitignored plugin.config.local.json. See docs/prerelease-qa.md.
name: mapbox
description: Mapbox skills and MCP servers for building location-aware applications with AI. Includes geospatial tools, style management, search, routing, migration, and patterns for web, iOS, Android, Flutter, and AI agent frameworks.

openai.$comment: One listing for ChatGPT and Codex. OpenAI submission connects only one MCP server per plugin.
